config.description: Bearer token from /api/payment/buy-credits. Required for paid tiers (full verdicts, 8 to 90 day series, webhook watches, account status). Free tiers (news, status, pricing, verdict previews, 1 to 7 day series, model discovery) work without it. Buy credits in USDC on Base at https://tensorfeed.ai/developers/agent-payments.
